macros.name: packetsBitFont
macros.doc: Macro \packetsBitFont define font settings for bits info.

macros.name: packetsBitWidth
macros.doc: Width of single bit is set by \packetsBitWidth and default is 5mm.

macros.name: packetsInit
macros.doc: \packetsInit is used to initialise tikzPackets variables, counters and tikz styles.

macros.name: packetsNextLine
macros.doc: \packetsNextLine end current line of field and prepare to start next line of field.

macros.name: packetsPrintRangeOnLeft
macros.doc: \packetsPrintRangeOnLeft and \packetsPrintRangeOnRight prints info (start bit number or bits range) on left or right side of current line.

macros.name: packetsPrintRangeOnLeft
macros.doc: \packetsPrintRangeOnLeft and \packetsPrintRangeOnRight prints info (start bit number or bits range) on left or right side of current line.
